init_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with local rank, shard id, and nccl backend
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all processes across machines and concatenate them along dimension 0
all_reduce_tensors: all reduce tensors across all processes with optional averaging by world size
all_gather_unaligned: gather arbitrary picklable data from all ranks using pickle serialization and gloo backend
synchronize: synchronize all processes with a distributed barrier when using multi-GPU training
